channel.title: CBS News World
channel.description: RSS feed for CBS News World

item.title: Musk chose to restrict Ukraine's access to SpaceX network, sources say
item.description: A decision by Elon Musk led to restrictions on Ukraine's use of SpaceX's satellite communications network, people familiar with the matter told CBS News.

item.title: Iran touts closest ever ties with Russia, contradicting Trump
item.description: Iran says its ties with Russia are stronger than ever after a visit by Putin's top envoy, challenging Trump's assertion that Moscow isn't helping Iran in the war.

item.title: Prince Harry says he hopes to reconcile with royal family
item.description: Prince Harry and his family returned to live in the U.K. six years after a very public split from the royals, including his father, King Charles. Harry is now hoping for a very public reconciliation to match. Leigh Kiniry reports.

item.title: Italy agrees to send Texas man accused of killing pregnant wife back to U.S.
item.description: A Texas man who was accused of killing his pregnant wife two years ago fled to Italy. Officials there have agreed to send him back to the U.S. to face charges on the condition that he faces a lesser charge, not capital murder. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: French government extends curfews after riots sweep across the country
item.description: French authorities are extending curfews and increasing the police presence in public spaces as President Emmanuel Macron's government tries to regain control after rioters torched buildings and looted thousands of businesses this weekend.

item.title: 10/20: CBS Evening News
item.description: A brake issue prompts an American Airlines emergency landing; Christina Applegate reveals a devastating misdiagnosis.

item.title: 10/20: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: 14 days until midterm contests; President Trump looks to boost Republicans in North Carolina elections.

item.title: Hegseth meets Netanyahu ahead of elections, possible Iran war restart
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel just over a week before Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stands for elections, and as President Trump floats restarting the Iran war.

item.title: U.S. ramps up warnings to Americans in Middle East after Houthi strikes
item.description: U.S. diplomatic missions across the Middle East have issued a new round of warnings to Americans amid attacks by Iran-backed Houthi militants against Saudi Arabia.

item.title: 2 men rearrested for alleged spying for Iran in U.K. air base incident
item.description: Police said a 24-year-old British national and a 25-year-old dual U.K.-Iranian national were arrested under the National Security Act.

item.title: Egypt weighs sending troops to Saudi Arabia in war with Iran-backed rebels
item.description: Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi rebels have intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, targeting airports and oil infrastructure.

item.title: Ukraine's military evacuates wounded soldier with aerial drone
item.description: Ukraine's military says a soldier reportedly trapped by Russian fire on the front line for more than a year was evacuated by an aerial drone.

item.title: Shark kills woman swimming off popular beach in South Africa
item.description: Local media reported the woman was a regular swimmer and had been swimming with a group when the attack occurred.

item.title: Man charged in "targeted" attack on Australian lawmaker Helen Haines
item.description: Australian police charged a man on Tuesday over what they alleged was a "targeted" attack with a vehicle on independent lawmaker Helen Haines.

item.title: Zelenskyy says if Trump can't stop Putin, help Ukraine do it
item.description: Ukraine's leader calls on Trump to allow delivery of interceptor missiles already purchased by European allies if the U.S. "cannot rein Putin in."

item.title: French authorities impose curfews as protests rage on
item.description: French authorities instituted a curfew across the country Monday night after protests ravaged the streets. Aidan Stretch reports.

item.title: Israel detains 40 ultra-Orthodox men accused of draft dodging
item.description: At least 40 ultra-Orthodox Jewish men were arrested at Israel's Ben Gurion Airport on suspicion of attempting to evade the country's military draft.

item.title: Voters reject separation of Alberta from Canada in referendum
item.description: The vote was not a referendum on independence from Canada, but it would have begun a process towards possible separation.

item.title: Zelenskyy says it's Putin who wants an endless war, not him
item.description: Ukraine's leader rejects Trump's accusations, says Putin is refusing peace, not him, and the U.S. military is delaying "vital supplies."

item.title: France vows to crack down after protests spiral out of control
item.description: French officials implemented local curfews Monday and said an "ultra-left movement" was behind widespread violence and vandalism amid anti-government protests.
